facts.text: Grab a plate and keep your voice down. Half the table is somebody I've been paid to follow.
facts.why: Set out as Gittes's spoken words under 'A word from Jake Gittes', but he never says it. His real reply at the Albacore Club lunch, when Noah Cross says the fish should be served with the head, is 'Fine. As long as you don't serve the chicken that way.'
facts.fix: Fine. As long as you don't serve the chicken that way.

facts.text: Gittes' order, nose bandage and all.
facts.why: Gittes has his nose slit by a man with a knife and wears the bandage through the film, but nothing in the transcript or plot shows him ordering a gin rickey.
facts.fix: Gittes' nose bandage, courtesy of a man with a knife.

vibe.verdict: A proper 1937 newspaper with the head on fish moment, but the food is mostly orange and fish puns and leaves out the best twists.
